# ECO-REACTOR-GENERIC — Run Reactor modules directly as Ash generic actions

Research finding 6 (high confidence, 3-0, the documented preferred initiation pattern): Ash generic actions support providing a Reactor module directly as their run option, with Ash action context (actor, tenant) passed into the Reactor context; qualifications: every Reactor input must map to an action argument, and transaction? true forces synchronous execution. This order answers openQuestion 2: whether converting multi-step flows to Reactor-as-generic-action simplifies ash_pplan's current adapter layer, and what breaks under transaction? true.
